newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates stay up in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates stay up in tight market.

text.p: Pakistani inter-bank rates remained pegged to higher levels on Monday amid a shortage of funds and were seen opening steady on Tuesday as no major inflows were likely, dealers said.
Overnight funds were traded in a range of 16.9 to 17 percent, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Dealers said borrowers used the discount facility of the State (central) bank of Pakistan and some two billion rupees were discounted.
